description: Universal stage-gate logic: how to apply gates differently based on vertical + project stage

gate_logic.philosophy: Gates are context-aware. Missing assets ≠ bad design. Stage determines strictness.

HIGH.meaning: core trust signal or critical conversion mechanic
HIGH.action: FAIL late-stage | WARN mid-stage | INFO early-stage
HIGH.blocking: true for late-stage, false for early

proof_asset.late_stage: WARN or FAIL depending on vertical

missing_asset.definition: Something that should exist by this stage but doesn't yet

design_issue.definition: Something present but violates winning patterns
examples: CTA text is vague (should be action-oriented)
Too much white text on light background

gate_result.actionable_next: string: what to do about it

early_stage.asset_status: may not have customers, testimonials, logos, or case studies yet
early_stage.gate_philosophy: permissive - establish patterns, guide direction, don't block
early_stage.goal: validate core messaging and tone fit for vertical

mid_stage.asset_status: have some real data, early testimonials, may lack logos/metrics
mid_stage.gate_philosophy: balanced - flag missing assets, enforce patterns, guide improvements
mid_stage.goal: ensure patterns are being applied correctly as real users come in

late_stage.asset_status: should have all critical assets (testimonials, metrics, logos, proof)
late_stage.gate_philosophy: strict - must have core trust signals, patterns enforced
